41 Powers of examination, etc

(1) This section applies where a relevant enforcement officer is exercising a power of
search conferred by section 37, 38 or 39 in relation to any premises.

(2) The officer may examine anything that is in or on the premises.

(3) The officer may carry out any measurement or test of anything which the officer has
power under this section to examine.

(4) The power conferred by subsection (3) includes power to take a sample from any live
plant.
